g.text: Busiest airports by number of routes — GET /api/airports/statistics/busiest (US210, contract B5)
GET (round-robin; failover to the next replica)
sums the counts of ALL its replicas
sort by count desc, then IATA;
Lookup by IATA (allowed to Backoffice Operator),
not the US108 search (ATCC only): the user's JWT
is forwarded to the peers, which apply the same rules.
